segments.ja485:1.1: Upanīyatidaṃ maññe, cande [lohitamadena majjāmi; vijahāmi jīvitaṃ pāṇā,(sī. pī. aṭṭha.)] lohitamaddane;
segments.ja485:1.3: Ajja jahāmi jīvitaṃ, pāṇā [lohitamadena majjāmi; vijahāmi jīvitaṃ pāṇā,(sī. pī. aṭṭha.)] me cande nirujjhanti.
segments.ja485:2.1: Osīdi [osadhi (sī. syā. pī.), osaṭṭhi (ka.), osati (abhinavaṭīkā), osīdati (?)] me dukkhaṃ [dukkhaṃ me (sī. pī.)] hadayaṃ, me ḍayhate nitammāmi;
segments.ja485:2.3: Tava candiyā socantiyā, na naṃ aññehi sokehi.
segments.ja485:3.1: Tiṇamiva vanamiva milāyāmi [milayāmi (sī.), miyyāmi (sī. pī. aṭṭha.)], nadī aparipuṇṇāva [aparipuṇṇiyāva (sī. pī.)] sussāmi;
segments.ja485:3.3: Tava candiyā socantiyā, na naṃ aññehi sokehi.
segments.ja485:4.1: Vassamiva sare pāde [vassaṃva sare pāde (sī.), vassaṃva sare pabbatapāde (pī.)], imāni assūni vattare mayhaṃ;
segments.ja485:4.3: Tava candiyā socantiyā, na naṃ aññehi sokehi.
segments.ja485:5.1: Pāpo khosi [pāposi kho (sī.), pāpo kho (syā. pī.)] rājaputta, yo me icchitaṃ [icchita (sī. syā. pī.)] patiṃ varākiyā;
segments.ja485:5.3: Vijjhasi vanamūlasmiṃ, soyaṃ viddho chamā seti.
segments.ja485:6.1: Imaṃ mayhaṃ hadayasokaṃ, paṭimuñcatu rājaputta tava mātā;
segments.ja485:7.1: Imaṃ mayhaṃ hadayasokaṃ, paṭimuñcatu rājaputta tava jāyā;
segments.ja485:8.1: Mā ca puttaṃ [putte (sī. pī.)] mā ca patiṃ, addakkhi rājaputta tava mātā;
segments.ja485:8.3: Yo kimpurisaṃ avadhi, adūsakaṃ mayha kāmā hi [mayhaṃ kāmā (ka.)].
segments.ja485:9.1: Mā ca puttaṃ mā ca patiṃ, addakkhi rājaputta tava jāyā;
segments.ja485:9.3: Yo kimpurisaṃ avadhi, adūsakaṃ mayha kāmā hi.
segments.ja485:10.1: Mā tvaṃ cande rodi, mā soci vanatimiramattakkhi;
segments.ja485:10.3: Mama tvaṃ hehisi bhariyā, rājakule pūjitā nārībhi [nārī (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja485:11.1: Api nūnahaṃ marissaṃ, nāhaṃ [na ca panāhaṃ (sī. pī.)] rājaputta tava hessaṃ;
segments.ja485:11.3: Yo kimpurisaṃ avadhi, adūsakaṃ mayha kāmā hi.
segments.ja485:12.1: Api bhīruke api jīvitukāmike, kimpurisi gaccha himavantaṃ;
segments.ja485:12.3: Tālīsatagarabhojanā, aññe [tālissatagarabhojane, araññe (sī. pī.)] taṃ migā ramissanti.
segments.ja485:13.1: Te pabbatā tā ca kandarā,[tā ca giriguhāyo (sī. syā. pī.)] tā ca giriguhāyo tatheva tiṭṭhanti [tā ca giriguhāyo (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja485:13.3: Tattheva [tattha (sī. syā. pī.)] taṃ apassantī, kimpurisa kathaṃ ahaṃ kassaṃ.
segments.ja485:14.3: Tattheva taṃ apassantī, kimpurisa kathaṃ ahaṃ kassaṃ [kāsaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.ja485:15.3: Tattheva taṃ apassantī, kimpurisa kathaṃ ahaṃ kassaṃ.
segments.ja485:16.1: Acchā savanti girivana [girivara (sī. pī.)] nadiyo, kusumābhikiṇṇasotāyo;
segments.ja485:16.3: Tattheva taṃ apassantī, kimpurisa kathaṃ ahaṃ kassaṃ.
segments.ja485:17.1: Nīlāni himavato pabbatassa, kūṭāni dassanīyāni [dassaneyyāni (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja485:17.3: Tattheva taṃ apassantī, kimpurisa kathaṃ ahaṃ kassaṃ.

segments.ja485:26.1: Vicarāma dāni girivana [girivara (sī. pī.)] nadiyo, kusumābhikiṇṇasotāyo;
